9.1.1 Sample Capitalization Rules

The following guidelines are a hand-written sample.

DO use PascalCasing for the names of public types and members.

For example, use TextColor rather than Textcolor. Single words, such as Button, simply have initial capitals.

A second annotation paragraph.

DO NOT use underscores in identifiers.

Underscores make names harder to read. Common offenders include:

  • leading underscores

  • embedded underscores, such as my_value

Click here to view code image

int my_value = ʘ;
int myValue = 1;

CONSIDER keeping names short.

Short names are easier to type.
